schemes_and_rights.name: Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act 2016
schemes_and_rights.overview: Rights-based statute covering 21 recognised disabilities, aligned with the UNCRPD.
key_provisions: 4% reservation in government establishments for persons with benchmark disabilities.
5% reservation in government and government-aided higher education institutions.
Non-discrimination and accessibility duties for public infrastructure and services.
Accessibility obligations for public transport, buildings and government websites.

schemes_and_rights.name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
schemes_and_rights.implementing_agency: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / ALIMCO and other implementing agencies
schemes_and_rights.eligibility: UDID card or UDID enrolment number with at least 40% disability, plus Aadhaar. 100% subsidy for monthly family income up to ₹22,500; 50% subsidy for ₹22,501 to ₹30,000.
covered_devices: Other devices in the current comprehensive list
financial_limits: Up to ₹15,000 for aids and assistive devices, once in 3 years.
Up to ₹50,000 subsidy for motorised tricycles or motorised wheelchairs, once in 5 years.

schemes_and_rights.name: UDID Card (Unique Disability ID / Swavlamban Card)
schemes_and_rights.overview: A single electronic disability identity card issued through the Swavlamban portal, intended to replace multiple state-level certificates.
benefits: Single card accepted for disability-related benefits across states.
Used for ADIP applications, scholarships and pension schemes.
Supports transport concession claims, subject to the operator's current rules.
notes: Do not state that the card is free; fees and timelines vary.
Do not promise a specific rail concession percentage.

schemes_and_rights.name: Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan (Accessible India Campaign)
focus: Ramps, tactile paving, lifts and accessible toilets in public buildings.
Accessible transport and auditory/visual announcements where implemented.
Accessible government websites under GIGW guidelines.
notes: This is not a cash benefit or an individual device grant.
Do not claim a specific number of retrofitted stations without a dated source.
